from collections.abc import Iterator
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict
from sqlalchemy import String, create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, Session, mapped_column, sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

engine = create_engine("sqlite://", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False)

class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass

class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = "items"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100))

Base.metadata.create_all(engine)

class ItemIn(BaseModel):
    name: str

class ItemOut(ItemIn):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: int

def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
    with SessionLocal() as session:
        yield session

app = FastAPI()

@app.post("/items", response_model=ItemOut, status_code=201)
def create_item(data: ItemIn, db: Session = Depends(get_session)):
    item = Item(name=data.name)
    db.add(item)
    db.commit()
    return item

@app.get("/items/{item_id}", response_model=ItemOut)
def read_item(item_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_session)):
    item = db.get(Item, item_id)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "not found")
    return item

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_and_read():
    r = client.post("/items", json={"name": "widget"})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    item_id = r.json()["id"]
    assert client.get(f"/items/{item_id}").json() == {"id": item_id, "name": "widget"}

def test_missing_and_invalid():
    assert client.get("/items/9999").status_code == 404
    assert client.post("/items", json={}).status_code == 422

import httpx, pytest, respx
from client import ApiClient

@pytest.mark.asyncio
@respx.mock
async def test_parses_repo():
    respx.get("https://api.example.com/repos/a/b").mock(return_value=httpx.Response(200, json={"id": 1, "full_name": "a/b", "stargazers_count": 5, "extra": True}))
    c = ApiClient()
    repo = await c.get_repo("a", "b")
    assert repo.full_name == "a/b" and repo.stargazers_count == 5
    await c.aclose()

@pytest.mark.asyncio
@respx.mock
async def test_retries_then_succeeds():
    route = respx.get("https://api.example.com/repos/a/b").mock(side_effect=[httpx.Response(503), httpx.Response(200, json={"id": 1, "full_name": "a/b", "stargazers_count": 0})])
    c = ApiClient()
    await c.get_repo("a", "b")
    assert route.call_count == 2
    await c.aclose()

@pytest.mark.asyncio
@respx.mock
async def test_404_raises():
    respx.get("https://api.example.com/repos/a/x").mock(return_value=httpx.Response(404))
    c = ApiClient()
    with pytest.raises(httpx.HTTPStatusError):
        await c.get_repo("a", "x")
    await c.aclose()

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, SecretStr
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

class DbSettings(BaseModel):
    url: str = "sqlite:///app.db"
    pool_size: int = Field(5, ge=1, le=50)

class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_prefix="APP_", env_nested_delimiter="__", env_file=".env", extra="ignore")
    debug: bool = False
    api_key: SecretStr
    db: DbSettings = DbSettings()

import pytest
from pydantic import ValidationError
from settings import Settings

def test_env_and_nested(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("APP_API_KEY", "s3cret")
    monkeypatch.setenv("APP_DEBUG", "true")
    monkeypatch.setenv("APP_DB__POOL_SIZE", "10")
    s = Settings(_env_file=None)
    assert s.debug is True and s.db.pool_size == 10
    assert s.api_key.get_secret_value() == "s3cret" and "s3cret" not in repr(s)

def test_dotenv(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("APP_API_KEY", raising=False)
    env = tmp_path / ".env"
    env.write_text("APP_API_KEY=fromfile\n")
    assert Settings(_env_file=env).api_key.get_secret_value() == "fromfile"

def test_validation(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("APP_API_KEY", "x")
    monkeypatch.setenv("APP_DB__POOL_SIZE", "500")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        Settings(_env_file=None)

from sqlalchemy import String
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column

class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass

class Account(Base):
    __tablename__ = "account"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), unique=True)

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import engine_from_config, pool
from models import Base

config = context.config
connectable = engine_from_config(config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {}), prefix="sqlalchemy.", poolclass=pool.NullPool)
with connectable.connect() as connection:
    context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=Base.metadata, render_as_batch=True)
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()

"""create account"""
revision = "0001"
down_revision = None
from alembic import op
import sqlalchemy as sa

def upgrade():
    op.create_table("account", sa.Column("id", sa.Integer, primary_key=True), sa.Column("email", sa.String(255), nullable=False, unique=True))

def downgrade():
    op.drop_table("account")

from alembic import command
from alembic.config import Config
from alembic.autogenerate import compare_metadata
from alembic.migration import MigrationContext
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, inspect
from models import Base

def cfg(url):
    c = Config()
    c.set_main_option("script_location", "migrations")
    c.set_main_option("sqlalchemy.url", url)
    return c

def test_upgrade_downgrade(tmp_path):
    url = f"sqlite:///{tmp_path}/db.sqlite"
    command.upgrade(cfg(url), "head")
    assert "account" in inspect(create_engine(url)).get_table_names()
    command.downgrade(cfg(url), "base")
    assert "account" not in inspect(create_engine(url)).get_table_names()

def test_models_match_migrations(tmp_path):
    url = f"sqlite:///{tmp_path}/db.sqlite"
    command.upgrade(cfg(url), "head")
    with create_engine(url).connect() as conn:
        diff = compare_metadata(MigrationContext.configure(conn), Base.metadata)
    assert diff == []
